calibration_gap.revive_condition: evidence that mid-range (non-bimodal) scores occur materially in practice — their data suggests the opposite; without it there is nothing for calibration to fix
calibration_gap.ruling: CONFIRMED AS CLAIMED, REJECTED AS WEDGE. 'Scores are calibrated probabilities' is asserted (Limits section) with zero calibration measurement anywhere published (P@1/R@5/MRR/precision/recall/F1 only). BUT their bimodal distribution (true 0.92–0.99 vs false 0.02–0.13, 'the threshold barely matters') leaves no material room where calibration changes a decision. An unmeasured gap with no demonstrated materiality is a hypothesis, not a wedge.

withhold_gap.revive_condition: a withhold-accounting demand signal, or a tester-to-subject bench (see retry) showing their refusals are unnecessary often enough to matter
withhold_gap.ruling: CONFIRMED AS UNMEASURED, INSUFFICIENT AS WEDGE. 'Every gate fails toward doing nothing' plus the 80KB refusal policy are stated without any refusal-path measurement (no refusal counts, no necessity analysis) — the JEV_FORCE_MOVED shape (claim about the unmeasured branch). BUT their 50/50 recall vs 28% chance already covers the underlying fear (hidden code) that withhold-accounting would serve. The gap is real and narrow — audit-trail grade, not product grade.

what_this_is_not: No judgment on their −30%/−38%/−41% paired-run figures (taken as stated per orders) or on the product's value. This rules ONLY whether calibration-plus-withhold constitutes a rival wedge on their published evidence. It does not.
